name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Feature: first step of the public-facing/Tailscale setup split. Added PluginConfiguration.ConnectivityMode (Public-facing vs Tailscale, set on the Pools tab) and gated pool creation on it - only a server that's actually port-forwarded to its own domain can create a pool, since every other member needs to be able to reach it directly; an install that's never made the choice (Unset) is treated the same as Tailscale, not as 'trust it'. Also fixed a real config-save bug found while wiring this up: pending pool invites (both incoming and outgoing) were never preserved across an unrelated main-page Save, so saving any other setting silently dropped them. The Tailscale auto-install/Funnel/invite-key side of the original ask is not built yet - this release only adds the connectivity choice and the pool gate. 281 tests, all green.
